description: This file defines a protocol and a class implementing service functionalities related to Mac node runtime, including screen recording and location services, for the OpenClaw project on macOS.

classes.name: LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices
classes.description: A class providing concrete implementations for MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices, handling screen recording and location services.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Asynchronously records the screen with specified parameters, returning the path and audio status.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with desired accuracy and optional max age and timeout.
